verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local inference runtime, so CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX, or any x86 CPU optimization. The only CPU-related item is a user's log showing a fallback to CPU when no ROCm library was found, which says nothing about instruction-set use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
